transcript.text: Last spring I was in Shanghai for a few days, and I remember casually browsing car options there just out of curiosity, even though I ended up using the metro most of the time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: On that trip I also got back into reading—someone kept talking up the novel "To Live", and I jotted it down as the one Sun Lei later checked out.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Funny thing is, my friend David Liu had already booked a Toyota Corolla for me back then—pickup was 2025-04-27 and it was for 4 days, so I didn’t have to think about it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: After I got home, I glanced at my bank app just to make sure everything had settled; the account number on that old screenshot was 6222021234567890, and David Liu’s name was still on the rental email thread.
